title: Video Vestige
author: Video Vestige
description: Video Vestige is a horror movie podcast hosted by Audrey (she/her) and Diana (they/them) exploring horror films through rotating seasonal themes, with occasional new releases or forgotten VHS from our basement. Each episode is a conversation between two friends who immerse themselves in the technical and emotional impact of a film. Join us if you’re horror-coded and into film analysis, production talk, or sapphic subtext laced with our hot takes. Think of us like a conversation in the parking lot after the movie ends.
